name: Whiptail

review.observation: Full original: pale longitudinal back stripes over dark flanks, slender pointed snout and very long thin continuous tail. Four foot endpoints are visible; far forelimb is small and its proximal attachment is body-occluded. Toe counts remain unconfirmed. Natural elongated proportions and broad margins preserved.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
